TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings an established delivery organization and governance suitable for KPPRA-compliant public works. We are an SECP-incorporated private limited company with active NTN/ATL status and provincial sales tax registrations. [CO-PROFILE] Our team base comprises 250 staff, including 6 PMP-certified project managers and 4 PEC-registered professional engineers, supported from offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi. [CO-PROFILE]

Certifications and management systems are aligned to the RFP’s emphasis on documented methodology, schedule control, and quality assurance. We hold ISO 9001 (quality management) and ISO 27001 (information security), and maintain CMMI Level 3 process maturity used on multiple bridge engineering and road construction deployments. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-039][CAP-003][CAP-016][CAP-028] Our project leadership model is led by PMP-certified PMs, reinforcing CPM-based planning and disciplined change/control reporting throughout the 24‑month period including monsoon constraints. [CO-PROFILE]

Quality Assurance / Quality Control will be implemented under our ISO 9001-aligned procedures, with inspection and test plans and hold points for earthworks, pavement layers, concrete works, and asphalt works. [CO-PROFILE] Our library does not yet evidence an owned on-site materials laboratory for soils, aggregates, concrete, and asphalt testing; we will address this through mobilizing a dedicated site QA/QC function and engaging accredited third-party testing support as required by C&W specifications. 

HSE will be managed under our documented HSE policy, with site safety plans on infrastructure deployments and a zero reportable fatality record on record. [CO-PROFILE]

Mandatory compliance gaps to close: we do not currently hold ISO 14001, nor PEC constructor registration in category C-A/C-1. [CO-PROFILE] We will address these via an eligible, PEC-registered JV/consortium partner and project-specific environmental management controls while pursuing ISO 14001 certification in parallel. [CO-PROFILE]
